verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's verification flows save a reusable configuration and provide a static link that can verify any number of users, which covers sending a no-code link to a one-off customer, contractor, or seller without an engineering integration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of QR code generation, explicit documentation that ops staff can create and share flows from the Dashboard with no code, and independent hands-on corroboration of ops teams using the static link.
